notes.title: Tiny Toy Tanks | Chapter 2 Sneak Peek
notes.content:
First of all, I would like to thank everyone who downloaded the game and played it. It's very encouraging to see so many people playing the game. We will continue to work on the game and release new levels, new tanks, and new mechanics.

I would like to announce that Chapter 2 is coming soon to the game. We are working very hard to have fun and challenging levels in Chapter 2. Moreover, we have added many new mechanics and enemy tanks.


[h1]Sneak Peek:[/h1]
[previewyoutube=Vsv-6V84yYA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]New Tanks:[/h1]
[h2]Artillery tank:[/h2] a new engineered tank that will lunch vertical missiles 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39070677/9fdec8fdc3d46fd210194de0ed053165b2e9b6cc.gif[/img] 

[h2]Shotgun tank:[/h2] Will shoot three rockets at once
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39070677/7fdc81853b5b70660f980bb65258b191296cfa73.gif[/img]

[h2]Lava tank:[/h2] Will form lava pool all over the level
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39070677/6c7049182319f684b4be0ac29daa15c98e135ac9.gif[/img]

[h2]Sprinkler Tank:[/h2] Will shoot in two directions at once
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39070677/2673a5a3cbf57cf21df9ba47be0da43e5341f356.gif[/img]

[h1]New Mechanics:[/h1]
[h2]1- Drones:[/h2] some tanks will have drones protecting it from incoming rockets using laser technology
[h2]2- Lava:[/h2] moving on lava will overheat the tank resulting in electronic malfunction leading to tank destruction
[h2]3- Green TNT:[/h2] will explode if touched by tank
